mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_review (video_id, admin_id, admin_name, action, reason, create_time) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{adminId}, #{adminName}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS videoId, v.title AS title, v.cover_url AS coverUrl, v.duration AS duration, v.create_time AS createTime, r.reason AS rejectReason, r.admin_name AS reviewerName, r.create_time AS reviewTime FROM video v LEFT JOIN video_review r ON r.video_id = v.id AND r.id = (SELECT MAX(r2.id) FROM video_review r2 WHERE r2.video_id = v.id AND r2.action = 2) WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 5 ORDER BY v.create_time DESC
